description: Fork of exp007 (separate Q/K, d_qk=32, n_heads=4, 8k steps, final 1.836) with FLAT learning rate for bit-LUT optimizer — constant peak lr=1e-3 for the entire run, no warmup or decay. AdamW on continuous params still uses warmup_cosine to 0.1×peak. Tests whether cosine decay on bit-LUT was over-throttling late-training sign-flips, given that the STE gate already dampens effective LR as latents grow.
